Limitation: Fitzpatrick17k and DDI use different disease label spaces.
DDI evaluation uses a harmonized 14-class space rather than the full 114-class space.
M2 + M3 has only 41.90% prediction coverage on DDI.
122 of 210 DDI predictions are outside the harmonized prediction space.
Complete internal Fitzpatrick17k performance records are not available for M3 and M2 + M3.
Fairness metrics capture different aspects of disparity and may move in different directions.
Public-dataset evaluation does not establish clinical deployment readiness.
